verdict.rationale: Figma Make's own docs support iterative chat-driven changes, element-targeted instructions via annotations and the draw tool, diff review of code changes, and version history to go back to earlier versions. Together these give targeted follow-up refinement plus recovery when something breaks, but nothing documents that follow-up prompts preserve working functionality. missing for 10: documented guarantee or mechanism that follow-up prompts avoid regressions, hands-on or independent corroboration of stable iterative editing.

support.subject: As a founder, I can refine my app through follow-up prompts without breaking what already works

citations.quote: you can start a new change while another chat is still working

Inspect changes to your app’s code](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/33649966245783) by viewing additions and deletions in the changed files.
